name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 🧮 Syrup calculator for bigger operations: totes, pallets and super sacks of sugar, your own tanks, "Hives to feed" with tank loads, and syrup bought ready-made.
🧰 Care › Gear: your boxes and frames on the hives and in storage. Storage follows the boxes you add and take off, and "Enough for spring?" shows what's short.
☠️ A dead-out now asks what happens to its equipment. With foulbrood, nothing gets reused or moved until the inspector has seen it.
🏷️ QR hive tags: print stickers from an apiary's page, then tap 📷 Scan a hive tag and that hive opens, ready to inspect.
🐝 Picking a hive: choose the yard first, then the hive from cards showing its boxes, queen colour and last inspection. Or search every yard.
✨ Easier to use: tap anywhere in a choice box, Enter goes to the next box, and buttons stand out more.
🥣 What's added to syrup is now by kind: feeding stimulant, vitamins or amino acids, probiotics, vinegar or citric acid, thymol, or other.
